name: ClaimIDX
description: Index of recurring software failures and replay-tested fixes that coding agents query before retrying; stored locally, with sharing to the public commons only when confirmed per claim (`CLAIMIDX_COMMONS=0` disables it). Install: `pip install "claimidx[server]"`; launch: `claimidx-mcp` · Registry: `io.github.claimidx/claimidx`
